ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity pixels (approx. 85% white) with high-contrast low-intensity pixels (approx. 15% black) concentrated on edges and localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field covering the majority of both lobes; low-intensity black banding along the trailing edges; dispersed low-intensity circular clusters and unaligned linear streaks across both lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping laterally from the notch, terminating in highly irregular, jagged distal tips with significant vertical deviation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of over 15 distinct, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (dark centers with lighter penumbras) distributed across the ventral field, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple, high-contrast dark linear pixel disruptions, primarily vertical and diagonal, varying in length and width across both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark patterns consisting of parallel linear abrasions on both lobes and significant jagged loss of material at the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark, irregular pigment patch located on the inner right lobe adjacent to the central notch.
